findings.title: Lightness values for .custom-message-length are inverted compared to original and desktop
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss` on line 102, `.custom-message-length` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The lightness percentages (30% and 70%) are swapped compared to the original value (70% for light themes) and the identical rule in `desktop/modal.scss` (line 94), which uses `70%` for `$primary` and `30%` for `$secondary`. This makes the hint text much darker on light themes and much lighter on dark themes than intended.
